description: Na₃NiO₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (2.27 Å) and one longer (2.34 Å) Na-O bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.50 Å. Ni is bonded in a linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.78 Å) and one longer (1.79 Å) Ni-O bond length. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-62°. In the second O site, O is bonded to five Na and one Ni atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₅Ni octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-62°.
